title: Puppet masters in Plato's Cave omitted from teaching

tellings.quote: in her latest book called encounters Diana writes that she refrained from teaching her students one thing about Plato's Cave allegory the existence of the Puppet Masters

plain: Plato's Cave is an old Greek story about prisoners who see only shadows on a wall and take them for reality. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a university professor, Diana Pasulka, writes in her book Encounters that she held back one detail when teaching it to her students: the puppet masters who cast the shadows. Michels raises it because it hints that someone may be staging what people see.
